headline: Kfin Technologies Limited: Amalgamation/Merger
sum: Amalgamation/Merger - KFINTECH: KFin Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors of the Company at their meeting held today have approved the Composite Scheme of Amalgamation.
